data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates two distinct critics with different evaluation criteria. frontier-claim-honest@v1 is evaluated on claim honesty, while frontier-above-floor@v1 is evaluated on whether the frontier is above a floor. SRC_001 asserts both fail the same 'mechanistic requirement imposed by school-0 policy' and lumps them together as 'both critics...failed to meet the mechanistic requirement.' But these critics are not both mechanistic-requirement critics — they target different evaluation dimensions. The sustained-flag adjudication must justify each flag against the specific commitment it checks, not blanket-attribute a single policy failure to both.
